title: Determination on Flock's ALPR portal data as "data hosting" under Civ. Code §1798.90.55(b) — follow-up to W013438
summary: Asks for any record reflecting a determination that Flock Safety's possession and publication of the Department's ALPR search-audit information on the transparency portal constitutes "data hosting" under Civil Code §1798.90.55(b), rather than a sale, sharing, or transfer of that information to Flock Safety. If no responsive record exists, asks the Department to affirm the search performed.

policy_promises.quote: the provision of data hosting or towing services" is not considered a sale, sharing, or transfer of ALPR information
policy_promises.tests: Whether the Department has any record establishing that Flock Safety's possession and publication of the Department's ALPR search-audit data on the transparency portal is lawful "data hosting" on the Department's behalf, given that W013438's determination described the portal as "maintained by Flock Safety," not the Department.

prior_pra_refs.note: W013438's 2026-09-21 determination — "The Flock Safety transparency portal is maintained by Flock Safety. The Department does not maintain a separate screenshot, printout, or export of the 'Prohibited Uses' section outside of the information available on the portal" — is the quoted basis for this request: if the Department doesn't maintain the portal, the lawful basis for Flock's possession/publication of the Department's ALPR data there needs to be something other than hosting on the Department's behalf.

filed_because: W013438's closure the same day framed the transparency portal as Flock-maintained rather than Department-maintained, which raises whether Flock's possession and public display of the Department's ALPR search-audit data there is lawful "data hosting" under §1798.90.55(b) or an unlogged sale/sharing/transfer to the vendor.
